title: Pezeshkian: US Aggression Against Iran Has No Logical Justification
text:
"Pezeshkian: US Aggression Against Iran Has No Logical Justification  "

""

"Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, in a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin, strongly condemned US actions against Iran, stating that major powers have no right to commit aggression outside the frameworks of international law.  "

"“The aggression carried out by the United States against Iran lacks any legal basis, scientific grounding, or logical justification,” Pezeshkian said.  "

"He went on to list a series of US-hostile acts: “They martyred our leader, they martyred our commanders, they martyred our scientists, they martyred our innocent students, and they struck our people. By no rational, intellectual, or international standard can such behavior be justified.”  "

"The Iranian president also criticized Washington’s self-proclaimed commitment to human rights and the rule of law, adding: “Unfortunately, they claim to uphold human rights and legality, yet their actions are not based on any verifiable framework whatsoever.”
